title: Shortest Completing Word
summary: Given a string licensePlate and an array of strings words, find the shortest word in words that contains all the letters from licensePlate.
statement: Given a string licensePlate and an array of strings words, find the shortest word in words that contains all the letters from licensePlate. Ignore numbers and spaces in licensePlate, and treat letters as case insensitive. If a letter appears more than once in licensePlate, it must appear in the word with the same frequency or higher. Return the shortest such word, and if there are multiple, return the first one that appears in the array words.
constraints: Ignore digits and spaces in the plate and compare letters case-insensitively.
Return the shortest word containing required letters with multiplicity; preserve input order on ties.
hints: The license plate is a case-insensitive multiset of letters.
Count required letters, then scan words from shortest to longest using stable ordering.
Choose first word whose Counter subtracts every required count to zero.
Stable length sorting preserves original order on ties, and multiset containment enforces duplicate letters exactly.
editorial: Stable length sorting preserves original order on ties, and multiset containment enforces duplicate letters exactly.
